query: I want to buy a ₹1 crore flat but I don't want to spend more than ₹30,000 per month on EMI. Is that realistic?
answer:
Not realistic.

With ₹1 crore, you are looking at a ~₹80–83 lakh loan at 8.5% over 20 years; that EMI is ₹72,000–75,000 per month — more than double your ₹30,000 ceiling. Even at 7.5% over 15 years the EMI is ₹73,000.

To keep EMI ≤ ₹30,000 you need a 30% down payment on a ₹50 lakh flat, or a longer tenure (25–30 years) on a ₹75–80 lakh flat. A ₹1 crore budget will not fit your EMI constraint unless you stretch the tenure beyond 25 years.
